Title: IoT connector preview feature in Azure API for FHIR retiring on 30 September 2022

Body.Content:
On 30 September 2022 IoT connector preview feature in Azure API for Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) will be retired. Before that date, migrate to MedTech service feature in Azure Health Data Services.

The MedTech service feature in Azure Health Data Services provides same capabilities as IoT connector preview feature in API for FHIR. Additionally, the MedTech service feature drives stronger security and supportability. 

Required action
Review the pricing and then follow the detailed steps to transition to MedTech service in Azure Health Data Services. After 30 September 2022, IoT connector feature in Azure API will not be supported.

Help and Support 
If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
